## 更新内容
- 新增剪贴板顶部回跳按钮
- 调整候选词条为圆角块展示
- 调整数字键盘返回键为双行竖向
- 调整编辑与符号界面为左侧操作栏
- 新增按下即输入按键响应模式
- 调整符号键长按触发简洁模式
- 优化退格键上滑两次清空文本
- 新增离线端侧手写输入功能

## Changes
- Added a scroll-to-top button in the clipboard window
- Changed candidate items to display as rounded pill chips
- Changed the number pad return key to a two-row vertical key
- Moved action keys in the editor and symbol panels to the left column
- Added an option to commit input on key press
- Allowed toggling concise mode by long-pressing the symbol key
- Improved swipe-up on backspace to clear the field in two stages
- Added on-device offline handwriting input
